run_evaluate_s2st: run streaming evaluation of Seamless UnitY models for speech-to-speech translation task
run_evaluate_s2tt: run streaming evaluation of Seamless UnitY models for speech-to-text translation task
run_evaluate_asr: run streaming evaluation of Seamless UnitY models for automatic speech recognition task
run_evaluate_expressive: run expressive streaming S2ST evaluation with SeamlessS2STAgent instead of default agent
run_evaluate_with_unity_model: run streaming evaluation with a custom unity model name and SPM tokenizer for latency metrics
